question_text: _____ is not an endocrine gland in humans.
explanation: Endocrine glands are the glands that secrete hormones. There are eight major endocrine glands scattered throughout the body: the pituitary, pineal, thyroid, thymus, pancreas, adrenal glands, ovaries (in females), and testes (in males). The liver is not an endocrine gland. The liver acts as an exocrine gland when creating and excreting bile to be stored in the gallbladder. Hence, the correct answer is "Liver".
